meta.promptText: India mein shaadi ke liye budget mein online konsi sarees kharidun?

response.text:
Shaadi ke liye budget mein **silk-blend, Banarasi-look, georgette ya chiffon saree** achhi rahegi—yeh festive dikhti hain aur ₹500–₹1,500 ke beech mil jaati hain.

### Budget ke hisaab se best options

- **₹300–₹600:** Meesho par Banarasi-look, Kanjeevaram-look, Paithani cotton-silk aur Mysore-silk sarees mil rahi hain; kuch options ₹267–₹639 ke aas-paas hain.[2][4][5]
- **₹700–₹1,300:** Libas ki silk-blend sarees zyada polished aur reliable option hain; sale mein designs lagbhag ₹759–₹1,259 ke mil rahe hain.[6]
- **₹1,000–₹1,500:** Embroidered silk-blend saree—shaadi ke guest, sister ya bhabhi ke liye best. Magenta, maroon, bottle green aur royal blue shades dekhein.[6]
- **₹2,000–₹4,000:** Thodi premium-looking **Banarasi silk-blend, organza ya heavy georgette** saree chun sakti hain.
- **Bride ke liye:** Agar aap dulhan hain, to ₹500 wali saree ke bajay ₹1,200–₹3,000 mein heavy embroidery, zari border aur attached/unstitched blouse wali saree dekhein.

### Kaunse colours chunen?

- **Dulhan:** Red, maroon, wine, rani pink, bottle green  
- **Shaadi guest:** Pastel pink, lavender, teal, mustard, royal blue  
- **Day wedding:** Peach, yellow, green, baby pink  
- **Night wedding:** Black, navy, wine, magenta, purple  

### Kharidne se pehle check karein

- Customer photos aur reviews zaroor dekhein.
- Saree ki length, blouse-piece aur fabric description verify karein.
- “Silk” ke naam par aksar **art silk ya silk blend** hota hai—pure silk samajhkar order na karein.
- Return policy, delivery date aur blouse stitching cost check karein.
- ₹300–₹600 range mein quality inconsistent ho sakti hai; trusted seller aur high-rating product chunna behtar hai.

**Sabse balanced recommendation:** ₹900–₹1,300 ki **silk-blend Banarasi-look ya embroidered saree**, matching blouse aur simple jewellery ke saath—budget-friendly bhi lagegi aur shaadi ke liye elegant bhi.[6]
